'''Ley'arsha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]] as part of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one|survey team six-eight-nine-mark-one]]. She led the excavation of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruins of [[Vodal Kressh]]. At some point during this process she was corrupted by the spirit of Vodal Kressh and converted into one of his followers.<ref name="TOR" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a strike team was sent to the Athiss ruins. Ley'arsha [[Mission to Athiss|confronted]] the strike team but was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Professor Ley'arsha serves as the first boss of Flashpoint: "Athiss" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
